_comment: Registration for the lane clause on `flow-plan-record.py compliance`'s verdict line (issue #1767).
WHY IT NEEDS COMMITTED CASES (ADR 0008): the PLAN_COMPLIANCE line is what a
run carries into its PR, and nothing downstream re-derives whether the lanes
a plan said it would test have anything recorded. While the answer was only a
note on stderr, five changes merged in three hours without the record.
THE GATE DOES NOT CHANGE ITS EXIT CODE FOR A LANE, by the owner's ruling (the
verdict line, not a refusal). So run-case.py reads the ONE verdict line the
gate printed and exits 1 when it carries a LANES clause, 0 when it does not.
The detection is the gate's own line; only the exit code is the runner's.
limits: Covers the clause for a missing demonstrated file, a will-test lane with no row, and a demonstrated file that exists and cannot be read, against a run with every lane shown and a project with no lane file. It does not cover the `unknown` verdict word, an unusable lane file at close, a waived plan, or the full combination table - those are pinned by tests/test_flow_plan_record_lanes.py. The exit code scored here is the runner's reading of the verdict line, not the gate's: the gate's own exit code never changes for a lane. It says nothing about whether a demonstrated row is TRUE.

cases.name: bad-no-demonstrated-file
cases.why: Two will-test lanes and no demonstrated file: the state of five merged changes on 2026-11-12. If it scores GOOD the line is silent about it again.

cases.name: bad-one-lane-has-no-row
cases.why: The file exists with a row for one of the two lanes. If it scores GOOD a file's existence is being read as every lane shown.

cases.name: bad-demonstrated-file-unreadable
cases.why: The demonstrated path is a directory. The line must say NOT CHECKED; if it scores GOOD an unreadable answer is being read as a clean one.

cases.name: good-every-lane-demonstrated
cases.why: Both will-test lanes have a row. Separates a working check from one wedged at reporting, and holds that writing the file does not itself change the verdict word.

cases.name: good-no-lane-file
cases.why: A project that has not adopted lanes: the line is what it always was. This is every repository but one today.

anchors.why: HISTORICAL: the helper as merged by #1731. It reports the lanes on stderr only, so its verdict line carries no clause in any of the three bad cases.
